_readme: One place for every affiliate link. Posts refer to a tool by its key, so a link only ever needs changing here. A tool shows in banners only once its 'link' is filled in (previews show a sample). 'topics' are the news and guide categories where the tool fits; 'tagline' is one plain, factual line (no claims we haven't checked).
